description: Fetch a public https URL that returns text and compute byte/char/line/word counts plus SHA-256 ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects. Rejects image/audio/video/octet-stream. Returns JSON { url, final_url, content_type, byte_length, char_count, line_count, word_count, sha256, warnings }. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

url.description: https URL that returns text to analyze. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: text-stats
